style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Distinct irregular chunky bluecyan/violet floating debris, broad soft native facets/edgevolume/readablecoloredlowers, open readable windup/burst/recoveryshrink in all registered views.

independentCriteria.shapeVolume: Distinct irregular chunky debris, coherent main facet planes and softer edges; readable three-dimensional turning volume in every required facing and state. Useful changes to proportions, topology, piece construction and decoration are welcome inside the reconciled functional design budget.
independentCriteria.color: Maintain blue/cyan and violet/purple identity across the moving burst. Warm cream/gold highlights may enrich crowns and edges without bleaching large areas or turning the whole effect orange. The palette must remain readable on light, gray and dark backgrounds.
independentCriteria.lightingHighlights: Broad soft light and controlled plane/edge highlights give solid volume without preferred horizontal lighting or directional ground shadows. Lower facets retain color and readable volume, avoiding black wedges, noisy specular flicker and flat uniformly bright surfaces.
independentCriteria.materialDetail: Facet hierarchy and restrained bevel/edge softness communicate polished cartoon stone or crystalline reef debris. Optional small chips and crafted plane breaks must survive intended size; thin glowing seams and dense microdetail are not goals by themselves.
independentCriteria.readabilityArtifacts: At logical 320x448 and representative phone half-scale, the burst must remain an open readable scatter with meaningful separated pieces and no clipping, halos, black patches, coplanar flicker, sudden scale pop or camera-facing impostor. Retain clean real transparency.
independentCriteria.motion: Preserve the authored windup, outward active burst, recovery shrink, 12 frames each at 12fps, nonloop terminal clamp and native facing transforms. Check all frames, including transitions and final held frames. A repeated review playback is presentation only; no loop-closing requirement is invented for these one-shots.

Use real measured enabled raw/evaluated geometry and motion bounds to let root define the design envelope. Nominal 1x1 metadata and height 0.9 alone are not per-frame geometry size locks.
No support floor, opacity law, joins, ports or attachment family constraints are added where none exist.
